name: offering-list-01
title: Offering List 01 - A Set Of Capabilities As Cards Or A Real Table
description: A capability catalogue with an optional search field, a filter slot, a caller-written result line and an empty state, drawn as cards or as a real table with named columns. The search is a pair, so a set of twelve rows does not carry a field that cannot reduce anything, and the state on each row is an open string with the tones mapped by whole-word match.
